questions.answer: Wery easy as I am from Denmark and the culture is much the same.

questions.answer: Use NTNUI as a place to meet locals.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Did not find any

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: The language and the cozy atmosphere

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Be prepared for slippery roads in the winter.
Use Bymarka a lot.
Use bumerang to rent gear.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: There are student discounts in most places in the city. Just ask for it.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: The amazing people I met and the trips we went on. The nature was amazing and seeing northern light was a big experience.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Balancing school and free time as there was so many things I wanted to do.
